answer: Give every new identity a voting weight that ramps up by 1/12 per epoch until it is fully trusted. In epoch one, 120 fresh clones carry only 120 x 1/12 = 10 full votes, and each must still lock 80 tokens, so the attacker ties up 9,600. A ledge of history is the beacon honest agents build slowly; a pearl cannot be bought in a single epoch.
